Ledyba

Bug Flying

Johto · Generation 2

Ledyba is a Bug/Flying-type Five Star Pokémon first found in Johto (Generation 2). It stands 1 m tall and weighs 10.8 kg. It evolves into Ledian. Its highest base stat is Sp. Def (80), with a base stat total of 265.
